sections.title: Performance Analysis: Crucible_Tools
sections.content:
This is a Node.js-based agent orchestration system, not a React app. There are no SQL ORMs or React components — the relevant patterns are **redundant disk I/O**, **repeated regex compilation**, **unbatched writes**, and **unthrottled sync calls**.

---

sections.title: 1. Redundant Disk Reads — "N+1 File Read" Pattern
2. Regex Recompilation on Every Call
3. Synchronous File Read on Every Status Render
4. Full File Content Read Just to Count Lines
5. `execSync('ps aux')` in Metrics Sync
6. Unbatched Write on Every `store()` Call
7. Session File Read/Write on Every Key Access
Summary Table
sections.content:
| Location | Issue | Impact | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intelligence.cjs:boostConfidence()` | 4 disk reads + 2 writes per feedback | High frequency | In-memory cache + deferred flush |
| `router.cjs:routeTask()` | 8 regex recompilations per call | Every tool use | Pre-compile at module load |
| `statusline.cjs:getLearningStats()` | 5 file reads on every status render | Every Stop event | 10s TTL memoization |
| `metrics-db.mjs:countFilesAndLines()` | Full file content loaded to count lines | Every 30s sync | Stream/buffer newline count |
| `metrics-db.mjs:countProcesses()` | `execSync('ps aux')` every 30s | Subprocess spawn overhead | 60s TTL cache |
| `auto-memory-hook.mjs:store()` | Full JSON serialized per entry during bulk import | Session start | Debounced/batched writes |
| `intelligence.cjs:sessionGet/Set()` | Full file parse/write per key access | Every route call | In-memory session object |

The highest-impact changes are items 1 (the `boostConfidence` disk I/O pattern) and 6 (unbatched writes during bulk memory import), as these fire on the critical path of every edit and every session start respectively.
